timeline.action: The athlete in a royal-blue tank top and black shorts stands in the throwing circle and begins the windup, holding the hammer wire; an official in a lime-green shirt stands to the right holding a clipboard.
The athlete rotates hips and swings the hammer back with the right arm; the official watches.
The athlete spins forward across the circle and swings the arm forward, releasing the hammer off-target to the right.
The hammer flies straight toward the official; the athlete stumbles forward completing the release.
The hammer strikes the standing official on the bottom; the official doubles over and recoils in pain.
timeline.sound: impact thud and a spectator shout

timeline.action: CUT to a white fluffy dog in a black tuxedo and white bow tie, centered behind two microphones on stands, black stage; it opens its mouth wide and the high opera note begins.
The singer holds the long high note, head tilted slightly back.
The singer launches into the Queen of the Night staccato run: the mouth opens and closes sharply on each note.
timeline.mouth: opening and closing fast, one shape per note

timeline.action: Staccato run continues, head bobbing slightly with each note.
The run climbs to the top note and holds.
